description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Irvine (Fire)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Irvine (Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Irvine after using a Fire ability, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Canister Shot+
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+, causes [Imperil Fire 10% (5s)]

description.name: Flame Ammo+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (? each), grants [Sharpshooter Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Irvine
description.text: Grants [Deadly Strikes +10% 1]/[Deadly Strikes +15% 1]/[Deadly Strikes +20% 1] after 0/1/2+ uses

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
